reserves.name: Inverse Staked DOLA deployed strategy positions

reserveReview.rationale: sDOLA is an ERC-4626 claim on DOLA held through the DOLA Savings Account. Inverse states that deposited DOLA remains in the sDOLA contract, is not rehypothecated or loaned, and can be unwrapped without a lock-up. The live adapter's deployed row therefore retains the tracked DOLA wrapper dependency rather than being treated as an unidentified strategy basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Live ERC-4626 deployed-position observation on 2026-09-21 plus Inverse sDOLA product disclosure
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unclassified wrapper-reserve exposure is present: the full wrapper reserve is the identified parent DOLA claim, whose own backing is evaluated on the DOLA record.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: At Ethereum block 26095807, savings() identifies the DOLA Savings Account and asset() identifies DOLA. The pinned source stakes deposits in that account and unstakes withdrawals. Inverse states that deposits are not rehypothecated or loaned to third parties. No enforceable legal segregation, bankruptcy-remoteness, or anti-rehypothecation terms were established, so those safeguards remain unknown. Governance retains the source-documented sweep function for ERC-20 balances in the wrapper other than DBR.
